fact: A supergiant of the Great Dog, so luminous it shines brightly from far across the galaxy.
bio: Wezen (Delta Canis Majoris) is a yellow-white supergiant around 1,600 light-years away. To appear as bright as it does from that distance, it must pour out tens of thousands of times the Sun's light — a star nearing the end of its life.
cultural: The name comes from an Arabic word for 'weight'. It lies in Canis Major, the Great Dog that follows Orion across the sky behind brilliant Sirius.
